datasets.name: OCS Planilla de Salud (FY2024, FY2025, 1Q2026)
datasets.authority: Oficina del Comisionado de Seguros de Puerto Rico
datasets.method: Direct download of the three OCS PDFs; text-layer extraction (PyMuPDF); every coverage row and total compared against detail pages (p1 premiums written, p2 claims paid, p3 insureds) and the summary page.
notes: The only two non-matches are the documented FY2025 claims conflict: the whole $196,246 difference between detailed page 2 (15,492,767,512) and summary page 8 (15,492,571,266) sits in the Private Individual Plans row (292,800,674 vs 292,604,428). The site uses page 2, consistently for the row and the total.
Source definitions: premium = premiums written; claims = claims paid; lives = number of insured (OCS 'Suscribers'). OCS prints no total-market MLR; the site's MLR is calculated.
Source anomaly: FY2025 PDF page 9 (age/gender) reprints FY2024 figures; not used by this site.
